summary:
Our site manage diabetes helps astronauts with diabetes(not a thing yet) manage their blood glucose level which is essential. We have 3 main features built into the site to complete this goal!
1) Our Food Dictionary
Based of Nasa articles and records of commonly ate food on NASA expeditions and missions we have put together this small dictionary for a simple way for astronauts to be able to figure out how many carbs are in their meals
2)Bolus calculator
The bolus calculator lets them enter in their meal from the dictionary and simply enter it in so they can focus on more important things like their mission!
3) logs
The logs lets you record your activity's. If this site was built upon I would add an ai tyo look for trends
details:
This site contains a carb dictionary, an insulin calculator and blood-glucose level monitoring (dummy data)

For the Carb dictionary we have used NASA data on their meals they feed their astronauts so we can get accurate as possible. Then predicted the carbs amount( They will be a bit off)

The Logging bit is where the astronauts will record their trends so they can spot them and fix habits!
